dimensions.label: Outcome
dimensions.explain: First-pass acceptance, final accepted tasks, regresi

dimensions.label: Contract
dimensions.explain: Scope adherence, permission attempts, false evidence/claim

dimensions.label: Reliability
dimensions.explain: Completion, tool/schema failures, repair count, provider availability

dimensions.label: Product quality
dimensions.explain: UI/accessibility, API/data behavior, maintainability, doc accuracy sesuai tugas

dimensions.label: Oversight
dimensions.explain: Konsumsi review Claude, jumlah intervensi dan koreksi manusia

dimensions.label: Economics
dimensions.explain: Worker API/compute/CI cost per accepted outcome, terpisah dari kuota langganan

dimensions.label: Performance
dimensions.explain: End-to-end p50/p95 latency dan queue/quota delays, dengan ukuran sampel

note: Keempat eksperimen memakai gate policy/authority, review dan security yang sama; belum ada hasil.
